description: Markdown to HTML — Render Markdown (CommonMark + GitHub tables, task lists, strikethrough, autolinks) to safe HTML offline. Raw HTML is escaped and javascript:/data: links are blocked, so the output is safe to insert into a page. Also returns a table of contents with heading ids and stats (words, reading time, links, images, code blocks, tables). Params: text (Markdown) or url (a .md file; GitHub blob links are converted to raw). Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_markdown
